name: Jovar +4
benefit: Massive 2-handed curved falchion with an exceptionally keen cutting edge. 2d6 slashing, 18-20/x2 crit.

name: Rapier +2
benefit: Finessable weapon. You can use Dexterity modifier instead of Strength for attack rolls with Weapon Finesse.

name: Spiked Chain +2
benefit: Two-handed finessable exotic weapon with reach and trip capabilities. Also qualifies for Shadow Blade.

name: Dagger (Shadow Hand)
benefit: Light finessable Shadow Hand weapon. With Shadow Blade and a Shadow Hand stance, adds DEX modifier to damage.

name: Sword of Defence +5
benefit: Defending weapon allowing wielder to transfer enhancement bonus to AC.

name: Heavy Shield +5
benefit: +2 base shield bonus + 5 enhancement = +7 total Shield AC.

name: Power Attack
benefit: Subtract number from melee attack rolls (up to BAB), add same number to 1-handed damage or 2x to 2-handed damage.

name: Weapon Finesse
benefit: Use Dexterity modifier instead of Strength modifier on melee attack rolls with light weapons, rapier, whip, or spiked chain.

name: Shadow Blade
benefit: While in a Shadow Hand stance, add Dexterity modifier to melee damage rolls with Shadow Hand discipline weapons.

name: Combat Expertise
benefit: Take up to -5 penalty on attack rolls and add the same number as a dodge bonus to Armor Class.

name: Punishing Stance
benefit: Iron Heart 1st: You deal an extra +1d6 damage on all melee attacks, but suffer a -2 penalty to AC.

name: Island of Blades
benefit: Shadow Hand 1st: You and any ally adjacent to the same opponent automatically flank that opponent regardless of positioning.

name: Child of Shadow
benefit: Shadow Hand 1st: If you move at least 10 ft on your turn, gain concealment (20% miss chance) until start of next turn.

name: Leading the Charge
benefit: White Raven 1st: All allies within 60 ft gain a bonus on charge damage rolls equal to your Initiator Level.

name: Mountain Hammer
benefit: Stone Dragon Strike: Deal weapon damage + 2d6 damage. This attack completely overcomes Damage Reduction and Hardness.

name: Steel Wind
benefit: Iron Heart Strike: Make one melee attack against each of two different opponents you threaten.

name: Shadow Garrote
benefit: Shadow Hand Strike: Ranged touch attack up to 60 ft dealing 5d6 damage and flat-footing target on failed Fortitude DC 13+Wis.

name: Charging Minotaur
benefit: Stone Dragon Strike: Charge and initiate a Bull Rush without provoking attacks of opportunity. Deal 2d6+Str damage on success.

name: Magic Missile
benefit: Fires magical darts of force that unerringly hit. Deals 1d4+1 force damage per missile (3 missiles at CL 5).

name: Shield
benefit: Creates invisible mobile shield granting +4 shield bonus to AC and negating Magic Missile.

name: Mage Armor
benefit: Surrounds subject with force field providing +4 armor bonus to AC (applies vs incorporeal touch attacks).

name: Bull's Strength
benefit: Grants a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength.

name: Mirror Image
benefit: Creates 1d4 + 1/3 levels (max 8) illusory duplicates that confuse attackers.

name: Scorching Ray
benefit: Ranged touch attack dealing 4d6 fire damage per ray (2 rays at CL 7).

name: Blade of Blood
benefit: Infuses weapon with negative energy. Deals extra 1d6 damage, or sacrifice 5 HP to deal +3d6 damage on next strike.

name: Potion of Cure Serious Wounds
benefit: Drinking heals 3d8+5 points of damage.

name: Potion of Bull's Strength
benefit: +4 enhancement bonus to Strength for 30 rounds.
